introduction:
瑞典经典喜剧片，“1001部必看的世界电影”之一。据说伯格曼很喜欢这部影片。
Paradiset is a boarding house in the archipelago of Stockholm, where the rich and noble spend their summers. Elvira Pettersson is the strict superintendent. Her assistant Lotta quits but when she leaves she accidentally forgets to turn off the iron. However, her brother Julle sneaks back one night to turn it off. When he is discovered, he tries to make them believe that he is the great opera singer they have been waiting for.
Elvira Pettersson runs the boarding house Pensionat Paradiset in the Stockholm archipelago. Her assistant, Lotta, quits her job, but forgets to unplug the iron. However, her brother Julle sneaks back one night to unplug it. When he's discovered, he fools them that he's the great opera singer they've been waiting for.
"Pensionat Paradiset" is one of the "1001 movies you must see before you die" (Swedish edition), but due to a copyright dispute it is officially not available for any viewing at all. Therefore, this is the only way to go.
